mechanism: Armodafinil induces CYP3A4 and CYP1A2, potentially reducing mebendazole plasma concentrations and efficacy, while mebendazole may inhibit CYP3A4 leading to increased armodafinil levels.
action: Monitor clinical efficacy of mebendazole for anthelmintic effect and armodafinil for excessive stimulation; consider alternative antiparasitic if reduced efficacy suspected.
